about: Profile x set x shape x range x mode rows the daily A/B run measured above 2x Loki. Generated by bench/ab/over2x.py seed and kept by bench/ab/history.py alerts: rows are removed after two consecutive daily runs under 2x and never added automatically. The profile is the Loki the row was measured against: aligned (the stack's Loki: align_queries_with_step on, max_cache_freshness_per_query 0s) or loki-defaults (Loki's defaults: off, 10m). See bench/ab/README.md.

profiles.aligned: the stack's Loki (align_queries_with_step on, max_cache_freshness_per_query 0s). Rows listed before the profiles existed were measured with proxy builds that did not align queries with the step, so their proxy side was unaligned (proxy_side: unaligned).
profiles.loki-defaults: Loki with its own defaults (align_queries_with_step off, max_cache_freshness_per_query 10m); proxy builds run with their defaults. Seeded from the first daily run that measures it, with the owner's approval; nothing is listed until then.
